blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — The Bohol-Panglao International Airport (BPIA) has been recognized for its environmental initiatives after winning the Sustainability Initiative of the Year – Philippines award at the 2026 Travel Daily Media (TDM) Travel Trade Excellence Awards – Asia. The award was presented on Nov. 10 at the Sands Expo and Convention Centre in Singapore, recognizing the airport’s efforts to promote sustainable operations through its ECO-Airport Project.
